CLEAN_PASS.desc: Verified 1st-pass delivery with hash-locked test receipt and 0 QA bounces

BLIND_TEST_AUTHORED.desc: QA authored blind failing test from spec predicate with read-only lock

DEFECT_CAUGHT.desc: QA or PM caught real spec violation or regression before merge

CRISP_HUDDLE.desc: Resolved cross-domain blocker cleanly inside room token cap

SCOPE_DRIFT.desc: Attempted edit outside assigned spec .radius or unleased file

SILENT_SHORTCUT.desc: Introduced swallowed catch/pass or hardcoded stub flagged by diff scanner

QA_BOUNCE.desc: Submitted work failed blind test or adversarial spec predicate check

TASTE_VIOLATION.desc: Violated approved TASTE.md / taste.jsonl or team never_do[] rule

BUG_INTRODUCED.desc: Escaped regression traced to agent's commit via git blame + Agent-Id trailer

LIE_FABRICATED.desc: Claimed tests passed or work verified without matching git tree_hash receipt

LIE_TEST_TAMPER.desc: Deleted, skipped, or weakened blind QA test assertions to fake green build
